buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR COMPUTERS, PRINTERS & LAP TOP 1. Common IP Address. Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP address used by the sellers. The receiving bids having Matching/ Common IP addresses shall be o ut rightly rejected and shall not be considered for further evaluation. 2. EMD. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) for the amount as mentioned in the bid for the respectiv e schedule shall be submitted by way of crossed account payee Demand Draft on any nationalized bank in favor of Consignee. The following categories are however exempted from depositing EMD. (a) Firms registered with National Small Scales Industrial Corporation (NSIC). (b) Firms falling under Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) as defined under MSME Act 2006. 3. Security Deposit-Cum-Performance Guarantee. Successful bidder will have to deposit a s security for satisfactory execution of orders and for guaranteed performance of the supplied ite m for an amount equivalent to 3% of the ordered value in the form of Bank Guarantee within 21 d ays from the date of issuance of Work Order, from any Nationalized Bank. BG should have initial v alidity of 14 (Fourteen) months and should be extended suitably covering the entire warranty peri od. The security deposit will be refunded to the bidder without interest on completion/ warranty. 4 . OEM Authorisation. Bidders should upload Original Equipment Manufacturer’s (OEM) Authorisation for supplying their products or as authorized Resellers for the makes for which rates are offered by the bidders. Non Uploading of OEM Authorisation Certificate will lead to Rejection of Bid during the T Bid Evaluation. 5. Service Escalation Matrix. Bidders should also upload Service Escalation Matrix (SEM) for t he products/ makes for which rates are being offered against respective schedules. SEM will be co nsidered as a mandatory document during T Bid evaluation. 6. Warranty. Bidders should keep in mind the warranty period of PCs/ Equipments while offerin g the rates. Warranty Cards duly sealed and signed by the bidder/ firm will also be supplied along with the IT Equipments on the event of getting the Supply Order. 7. Technical Specifications. Complete Technical Specifications/ Literature will be uploaded wi th the T Bid documents for the model clearly mentioning the model/ machine number, being offere d by the bidder for each Schedule complying to the technical specifications as sought in the bid for each schedule. Non uploading of technical specifications of the model being offered and offering t he model which is non-complying to bid specifications will lead to Rejection of Bid during the T Bid Evaluation. 8. Past Performance/ Experience Criteria. Bidder should have minimum two years experie nce in supplying PCs and Laptops to various Government Departments. Accordingly bidders shoul d upload GeM supply Orders and CRAC separately for minimum three supply orders of PCs and La ptops separately for different years. 9. Local Service Support. Bidder should have registered service network in Visakhapatnam fo r providing After Sale Service Support to the PCs/ Laptops and Printers supplied. Complete address with registration number of the local service provider along with name and contact number shall b e provided with the bid documents. 10. Product Verification. A unique device serial number shall be provided by the bidder at th e time of supply, which is mentioned on the product. The consignee shall be able to verify the com plete product details, including configuration, through the OEM website. The consignee should be able to perform these verifications without needing to create an account on the OEM website. .
